tytul: Ripe tomatoes pickled with onions: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for ripe tomatoes pickled in vinegar with onions.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to an FDA list, tomatoes have an approximate pH of 4.30–4.90, and the value varies widely with variety and conditions.
The FDA list gives white onions a pH of about 5.37–5.85.
Most mixtures of low-acid and acid foods have a pH above 4.6 unless the recipe contains enough lemon juice, citric acid or vinegar.

akapity: NCHFP has a tested recipe for sweet pickled tomatoes with onions, but it is made with green tomatoes.
Green tomatoes are more acidic than ripe ones.
This card is about ripe tomatoes.
Do not change the proportions of vinegar, vegetables and water and do not use vinegar of unknown acidity; use only recipes with tested proportions.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for ripe tomatoes pickled with onions from a checked source.
